text:
Maya (CS): FYI we saw a partial failure in the onboarding webhook router overnight affecting ~9 tenants. some connector steps retried and a few customers reported delayed finalization. logging impacted list in the incident doc: https://redwood.share/inc/2488880000 :warning:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-7011 | Severity: P3 | Affected: ~9 onboarding tenants | Eng notified

Dmitri (Onboard): breakdown: 5 SMBs, 4 mid-market. 2 mid-market accounts have go-live scheduled this week; renewal risk if we don't proactively reach them.

Maya (CS): proposed comms: 1) short status note to all impacted; 2) prioritized outreach + offer of 72h account credit and 90-minute concierge slot for the 2 go-live accounts; 3) capture a quick post-call sentiment question. Need eng RCA blurb + legal okay.

Lina (Eng): root cause: transient message duplication in router caused some handlers to back off; we fixed router rules at 03:05 UTC and cleared the backlog. will provide a 1-paragraph RCA for the email.

Jules (Legal): credits/concierge offer fine. keep tone factual and avoid SLA language. I can review templates in 45 mins.

Priya (AM): please add me to the two go-live accounts. if either signals timeline impact, I'll escalate and propose extended onboarding hours. 72h credit acceptable.

Maya (CS): draft outbound (concise):

"Hi <Name>,

We experienced a brief processing delay during last night's onboarding run which affected finalization for a small number of customers. The issue has been resolved and we processed outstanding steps. We're sorry for the inconvenience. To help, we'd like to offer 72 hours of account credit and a prioritized 90-minute concierge session. Reply if you'd like us to schedule.

— Maya, Customer Success"

Lina (Eng): suggested RCA line: "Cause: transient router duplication that triggered handler backoff; Fix: corrected routing rules and reprocessed backlog; Impact window: 03:00–03:05 UTC; Mitigation: added dedupe checks and alerting."

Maya (CS): action items:
- send status email to all impacted within 60 mins (owner: Maya)
- AM 1:1 for 2 go-live accounts (owner: Priya)
- legal review of template (owner: Jules)
- eng to paste final RCA in doc (owner: Lina)
- capture post-call 3-question sentiment form (owner: Dmitri)

Priya (AM): will take the 1:1s and flag any churn signals. good plan.

Maya (CS): I'll post the outbound copy after legal thumbs-up and start outreach. will report back after first 4 contacts. :white_check_mark:
